subject.title: fix(openrouter): apply request policy to music generation requests

question: Should OpenRouter music generation honor `models.providers.openrouter.request.allowPrivateNetwork` while OpenRouter video generation continues to override that setting to `false`?
rationale: The shared API and docs support an explicit operator opt-in, but current sibling capability paths encode different security policy, making this an owner decision rather than an automated merge choice.

options.title: Honor the explicit opt-in
options.body: Merge the current behavior so music requests use configured private-network policy while remaining strict by default when the option is unset.

options.title: Forward transport policy only
options.body: Keep `allowPrivateNetwork: false` for music while forwarding configured headers, proxy, and TLS settings.

options.title: Align all media paths
options.body: Pause this PR and make one owner-reviewed private-network policy decision covering OpenRouter music, video, and other media requests.

recommendation.title: Honor the explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Merge the current behavior so music requests use configured private-network policy while remaining strict by default when the option is unset.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shipped OpenRouter routing-policy work is the closest concrete history signal for ownership of this provider-policy choice.
